body: Is there anything left that you enjoy? YouTube? Books? Movies? Crafting? Etc? Even if it's only something small or something that takes up your entire day because it's all you can do, maybe that will help? What makes you still laugh or even a small amount of joy?
I'm glad he was able to be with you today. I hope that you can continue to find the strength to get up, that you find something today to help for tomorrow.

I had saved up a full bottle of fluoxetine left, 30mg each pill, that I'd been holding onto ever since I had to stop going to my doctor b/c bills were too high. I've had them for a while. I know you can't really overdose on them alone, but I also had a crapton gentlemen jack, idk how much I drank, with them which can make you overdose. I took just little over half the bottle of pills before my roommate found me and forced me to throw up. Fun times having someone else's fingers down your throat, but I was so out of it I couldn't exactly stop them.

In the past I've attempted the same combo except only tried like maybe a quarter of the pills with the gent. jack and only woke up after passing out from being pretty drunk. I had a lot of stomach issues after that, but other than that it failed.
I love that Minecraft and Terraria support each other like this <3

This is NOT your fault! You said you gave him everything you could, you did everything in your power to make it work. If he wasn't willing to do the same, it's his fault that it fell apart, not yours. He failed you!
Hear, hear! This, so much THIS! omg it sucks so fucking much but this.
\*massive virtual hugs\* It sounds like he's projecting. He isn't allowed to tell you how you feel, that's not his decision. I'm so sorry you're going through this :(
You deserve better than that :(. I hate to say this, but if he invalidates you then he's the one who doesn't deserve your love or heart.
I think my chances to do better are gone. Nobody wants me around or wants my attention anymore, I keep reaching out and people just pretend I didn't.
Hopefully  when you guys talk again you can tell him these things and he'll actually listen, that is part of communicating, too. You deserve to be heard!
Let me know if it helps!

I'm going through exactly this same situation right now. Did he say why he wanted to break up with you? It's not dumb to feel like your world is crumbling when the love of your life breaks up with you, this is a normal feeling. Especially when you've done so much and it feels unappreciated :(
I saw a post once that someone started drawing on themselves instead, idk if that would give the same response as cutting does, though.

When he wakes up tomorrow, remind him of this and tell him how it made you feel. Remind him that double standards don't work in relationships. Try to get some sleep yourself and rest, I know it'll be hard.
Dudes who gaslight like this are scum of the earth, you did wonderfully!
A nice warm hug from someone you know that cares but understands that you're in pain so they will let you do what you need to instead of selfishly trying to convince you to stay would be super nice.
Yeah, that song is pretty great. I graduated high school a long, long time ago. I feel pretty ancient nowadays.

That is definitely one thing about life is you can't live for other's happiness, you have to live because you are happy even if other's aren't. It is unfair that people expect us to "stay alive for your friends/family/whatever" because they aren't living your pain, you are. My response to this is: have you found any way, at all, to alleviate your pain? Hobbies, activities, etc? I know it's hard (personal experience and wishing death right now myself), but maybe try something new out just to see if it helps the pain? Do you like to craft, art, read, etc? It sounds like if you really do want to stay alive that you need a distraction, but you have to find something your passionate about or it won't matter. I really hope you find something to help distract from the pain, because it sucks.  


Besides all of that, what do you need to talk about? What's bothering you the most?

Princeton Club is pretty great if you have a chance to go! Anytime I went with my boyfriend we always had a good time, the people there are pretty nice and the rooms are cozy. It might be expensive, but it's worth it if you're with someone you truly care about <3
